One-line description: App to pay rent by credit card.
Time commitment: Sameer full-time since June 2026. Divya full-time since August 2026.
What have you built?: A mobile app that lets users pay rent by credit card. We pay the landlord's bank account through a payment aggregator partner.
Users: 1,900 registered. 1,100 have paid at least once.
Rent volume: INR 6.1 Cr paid since July 2026 across 2,400 payments.
Revenue: Users pay a 1.8% fee: INR 11 L gross. After the 0.9% we pay the payment partner, net revenue is INR 5.5 L.
Customer acquisition: Mostly organic and word of mouth. In small paid tests we saw about INR 120 per registered user. We have not measured cost per paying user.
Dependencies: We rely on a single payment aggregator partner. Banks and card networks have changed rules on rent payments before, and a change would hit us directly.
Existing investors: None. Founders have put in INR 18 L of savings.
Anything else we should know?: We believe rent is a large, underserved payment category.
Founder background: Sameer Qureshi (CEO): Product manager at a fintech for 4 years; launched two payments features. Divya Menon (Growth): 5 years in consumer marketing.
